title: Rational gap promise
statement: Let an encoded maximization problem have a set of well-formed Boolean-string instances and an optimum value for each Boolean string, and let $s,c\in\mathbb{Q}$ satisfy $s<c$. Its associated binary promise problem designates as yes-instances the well-formed inputs whose optimum is at least $c$, and as no-instances the well-formed inputs whose optimum is at most $s$.
hypotheses_covered: The input is an encoded maximization problem
Yes-instances are well-formed inputs with optimum at least $c$
No-instances are well-formed inputs with optimum at most $s$
